name: Ma o Haramu Shimai
source:
This tale takes place long before "From the Wombs of the Buki, Hell Will Be Born"

Ariana and Mira live in the countryside far away from the imperial capital.

However, one day, their peaceful days were stolen away from them.

They lose their hometown, and set out on a journey of revenge.

However, awaiting them at the village they arrive at is an unbreakable curse that makes them uncontrollably horny.

As monsters and insects unleash their beastly lust on the women, the women slowly awaken to their own sexual desire...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE293836.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这个故事发生在《从布基人的子宫里诞生，地狱将诞生》之前很久

阿莉安娜和米拉生活在远离帝都的乡村。

然而有一天，他们平静的日子被夺走了。

他们失去了家乡，踏上了复仇之旅。

然而，在他们到达的村庄里，等待着他们的却是无法打破的诅咒，让他们无法控制地饥渴。

随着怪物和昆虫向女人释放兽性的欲望，女人也慢慢觉醒了自己的性欲……
